audience: This course is designed for absolute beginners and near-beginners. The typical learner is one or more of the following:
Small-business owners and staff — food vendors, tailors, salons, barbers, traders — who need product and business
photographs but cannot pay an agency.
Aspiring freelance photographers who want a practical foundation and a first portfolio to show.
Content creators and social media managers whose still images are let down by poor light and framing.
Church, school and NGO media volunteers who photograph services, programmes and announcements.
NYSC corps members and students who want a practical, income-earning skill they can use immediately.
Event assistants who want to support a photographer at birthdays, weddings and naming ceremonies with confidence.
Parents and hobbyists who want sharp, clear photos of family, food and milestones.
